project_context.goal: Transform a static React site into a 2026-era modern, highly animated, 3D-inspired marketing experience.

theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an IATF 16949 certified automotive manufacturer, the design must exude precision engineering, authority, and modern robotics. A dark, cinematic metallic theme with stark red accents achieves the 'Godly' 2026 3D feel without losing B2B credibility.

fonts.weight_strategy: Use font-black (900) or font-extrabold (800) for massive hero text. tracking-tighter is MANDATORY.
Use font-light (300) or font-normal (400) for high readability.
Use for numeric counters, overlines, and technical specs. tracking-widest for uppercase overlines.

motion_and_3d_strategy.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY. Wrap the main layout in `<ReactLenis root>`. This gives the page the heavy, premium momentum required for 2026 aesthetics.
motion_and_3d_strategy.hero_3d_effect: Instead of heavy WebGL, use Parallax + Framer Motion. Layer the background image, apply a slow scale-up animation (`scale: 1.05`), and use `useScroll` to map the Y offset. Text must stagger in with a 3D rotation (`rotateX: 90 -> 0`).
motion_and_3d_strategy.card_tilt: For all Service and Facility cards, implement a custom Framer Motion 'Tilt' effect. Map `onMouseMove` to `rotateX` and `rotateY` via `useMotionValue` and `useSpring` to create an interactive glassmorphism 3D depth effect.
motion_and_3d_strategy.animated_counters: Home page stats (40+, 250, 60M, 35M) MUST use Framer Motion's `useSpring(0, { mass: 1, stiffness: 50 })` triggered when `whileInView` fires. Do not just use static numbers.
motion_and_3d_strategy.page_transitions: Wrap routes in `AnimatePresence`. Page enter: `opacity: 0, y: 20, filter: 'blur(10px)'` -> `opacity: 1, y: 0, filter: 'blur(0px)'`.
motion_and_3d_strategy.staggered_reveals: List items (competencies, services) MUST stagger in. Delay children by 0.1s using `transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 }`.

layout_and_spacing.section_padding: Massive spacing. Default `py-24` or `py-32`. No cramped sections.
layout_and_spacing.bento_grids: Use Mode A 'Tetris Grid'. Avoid equal columns. Mix `col-span-12 md:col-span-8` with `md:col-span-4` cards.

component_rules.buttons: Primary CTA: Flat pure red (`bg-[#FF2A2A] text-white`). Hover state: Expand width slightly or add a subtle red drop-shadow. No border-radius (sharp corners `rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm` for industrial feel).
component_rules.cards: Dark metallic glass: `bg-[#13151A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5`. Hover: `border-white/20`. Add a subtle inner light beam effect using a radial gradient mask if possible.
component_rules.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism sticky header: `fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#0A0A0C]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5`. Must have a solid background, never completely transparent.
component_rules.testing: MANDATORY: Every interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs) MUST have a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='contact-submit-button'`).

home.hero: Cinematic dark background overlay (`bg-black/50`). Huge typography (`text-6xl md:text-8xl`). Staggered text entrance. Parallax image.
home.stats: Grid of 4 counters. Numbers scale up and count from 0. Font: JetBrains Mono.
home.services_preview: Bento grid (6 services). 3D hover tilt on cards.
home.trusted_by: Infinite marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) of white logos on dark background. Slow speed, high opacity (0.5 to 1 on hover).

about.company_profile: Split layout. Text on left, sticky image on right with parallax. Reveal text blocks on scroll.
about.competencies: List of industrial capabilities that slide in from the left sequentially.
about.facilities: 3 plant locations. Large cards with hover-zoom images (`overflow-hidden`, image `scale-110` on hover).
about.quality_policy: Full width dark section. Large quote typography. Cinematic lighting.

services.hero: Minimalist header with red accent line.
services.explorer: Shadcn Tabs customized for industrial look (no pills, use sharp active borders with Framer Motion `layoutId` for the active indicator).
services.detail_cards: In-depth info revealing smoothly via `AnimatePresence` when a tab is clicked.

careers.hero: Dynamic video or high-energy photo of factory workers/engineers.
careers.job_listings: Accordion or list. Hovering a job row changes the background color and adds a right-arrow icon sliding in.
careers.application_form: Shadcn Form elements. Sharp inputs (`rounded-none`, `bg-[#13151A]`, `border-white/10`). Focus state: `ring-1 ring-[#FF2A2A]`.

contact.layout: Two column. Left: Form. Right: Map/Details.
contact.form: Floating labels or clean modern inputs. Submit button has a 'sending' micro-animation.
contact.details: Hover over email/phone applies a magnetic pull effect or text scramble animation.

media.placeholder_logos: Use Lucide-React icons (e.g., Settings, Car, Shield, Activity) as stand-ins for brand logos if specific SVG assets are unavailable, but place them inside generic circular/square company logo containers to simulate the 'Trusted By' section.
